text: Trying to save your first $10,000?
Stop worrying about $10,000.
Focus on your first $1,000.
Here are four things I'd do, starting with my next paycheck.
Number one: pick an amount you can actually afford to save.
If you save $100 a week, that's $5,200 in one year.
Keep that up, and you'll reach $10,000 in less than two years.
Can't afford $100?
Start with $25.
The important thing is building the habit.
Number two: open a high-yield savings account.
Keep your savings separate from your spending money and set up automatic transfers every payday.
Number three: look at your last 30 days of spending.
Find two or three things you can cut back on.
You don't have to stop enjoying life just to save money.
Number four: give your extra income a purpose.
Overtime, side hustles, bonuses.
Before you spend it all, put some toward your $10,000 goal.
And remember, your first $10,000 isn't built in one paycheck.
It's built by what you consistently do with every paycheck.
Save this video and start working toward your first $1,000.
